architecture: Channel-local log input/readout, perchannel8or24SiLUunits plus local linear skip; output10^min(raw,0). All padded to264hidden, first8units and skip identical perseed. Exact log labels computed from positive physical gates in FP64 before exponentiation; no teacher powers fixed inside learned model.
objective: All same balanced fit-only pools, based on exact-log decade labels. Legacy=(log10(pred+1e-30)-floorlog)^2/900+absoluteMSE. Raw=(raw-targetlog)^2/900+absoluteMSE with floorlog or exactlog. Exact versus floor at same units is isolated; legacy versus raw is distinct contrast. Current thresholds remain unchanged.
selection: Common development exact-log MSE/900 + absoluteMSE, earliestties, frozen beforefresh. Report perchannel/perbin raw and current errors. Sampling identical acrossarms, no fresh adaptation.
solver_control: Fit channel-local linear coefficients to floor and exact log labels separately using only fit data; no known exponents supplied. Compare fresh errors, rank/conditioning, and coefficient readout. Solver control is not an automatically deployable recurrent model.
